dream.hexerei.nightmare: You are dragged into a nightmare.
hexerei.book.grimoire.landing:
“Everything has its price.”

The collected workings of the hedge-witch — altars, the garden, the cauldron, and the rites.

hexerei.grimoire.altars.landing.name: The Hedge-Witch's Altar
hexerei.grimoire.altars.landing.p0:
The altar is the heart of every working.

Simply place the altar block and it forms its multiblock automatically — there is no GUI ritual to perform. Surround it with living nature, and it gathers power.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.landing.p1: Right-click the altar to see its current and maximum power. After adding or removing nearby nature blocks, right-click again so it rescans and updates its capacity.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.landing.p2: Crafted from potions, stone bricks, and logs — three altars to a batch.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.power.name: Drawing Power
hexerei.grimoire.altars.power.p0: Power comes from the natural blocks around the altar — each crop lends a little, flowers a little more. Brews and rites spend this power, and a working that cannot pay is refused before it consumes anything.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.power.p1: Stored power recharges slowly over time. The altar only recounts its surroundings when placed or right-clicked, so revisit it after reshaping the garden.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.spirits.name: Spirits & the Soul
hexerei.grimoire.altars.spirits.p0: Hexerei is not a craft of dead materials but of relationships. A spirit is not a beast to be slain — it is a bond between you and one of the world's six domains: Forest, Stone, Water, Death, Sky, and the Threshold. Any creature you may see is only a projection; the bond itself is the real thing, and it remembers.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.spirits.p1: Every working is an act — a small push upon a bond. Acts do not take hold all at once; they add up over time into state. A spirit carries a disposition (debt, resentment, fear, and loyalty), and the land itself carries disturbance in each domain. You never set these by hand — only acts move them.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.spirits.p2: The balance is not even. Care and attention can heal a bond, but debt never fades on its own, and a spirit's resentment never falls below what you owe it plus the marks you carry. Slights are remembered longer than kindnesses — keep your debts short.
hexerei.grimoire.altars.spirits.p3: Above all, one law: every source of power is a source of danger. The same act that wins you a spirit's gift disturbs its domain, and a disturbed domain pushes back — through failed rites, restless places, and worse. Spend, but know what you spend.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.growing.name: Tilling the Witch-Garden
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.growing.p0: Witch-herbs are planted on tilled farmland, like vanilla crops, and will not stack. They need light level 9 to grow, and bonemeal hastens them.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.growing.p1: Two herbs break the rules: Water Artichoke is planted on water, and Wormwood grows tall, stacking upward as it matures.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.mandrake.name: Mandrake
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.mandrake.p0: Mandrake — its root is the most iconic Hexerei ingredient. The screaming mandrake creature is a tale for another day; for now the plant simply yields its root.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.belladonna.name: Belladonna
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.belladonna.p0: Belladonna — sow the seeds on farmland; a mature plant drops a Belladonna Flower and more seeds. A staple brewing ingredient.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.artichoke.name: Water Artichoke
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.artichoke.p0: Water Artichoke is planted on water. It is edible and very filling, and brews into draughts of sight and swiftness.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.garlic.name: Garlic
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.garlic.p0: Garlic is both seed and produce. A humble ward against the dark — and a kitchen staple besides.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.mindrake.name: Mindrake
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.mindrake.p0: Mindrake yields a single bulb that serves as both seed and harvest — plant it again to grow more.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.hellebore.name: Hellebore
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.hellebore.p0: Hellebore (formerly called snowbell) drops snowballs when harvested, and now and then a sharp Icy Needle — a brewing reagent.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.crowseye.name: Crowseye
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.crowseye.p0: Crowseye is a farmland berry-bush. Sow the seeds on tilled soil; bonemeal brings it on quickly. Its dark berries are gathered as a reagent.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.celandine.name: Celandine
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.celandine.p0: Celandine is a common farmland herb, hastened by bonemeal. Its bright sprigs are cut and dried for the cauldron.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.hops.name: Hops
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.hops.p0: Hops grows as a tall self-stacking vine, like wormwood — a mature lower stalk pushes up a second segment. Harvested for its bitter cones.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.sandwort.name: Sandwort
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.sandwort.p0: Sandwort is a slow, hardy herb of dry ground. It does not leap ahead from a single bonemeal — each use adds just one stage — but it asks little to thrive.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.mistletoe.name: Mistletoe
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.mistletoe.p0: Mistletoe is no farmland crop — its sprig is planted onto logs or leaves, where it roots in the wood and grows a parasitic bough.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.zevanty.name: Zevanty
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.zevanty.p0: Zevanty is a glowing cave-mushroom that gives off a soft light. Break a mature cap to gather the mushroom; now and then a Glowing Spore falls with it — a threshold reagent.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.glowing_spore.p0: A faintly luminous spore shaken loose from Zevanty (about one cap in four yields one). A reagent of the Threshold — it carries the curse of unluckiness.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.puffball.name: Puffball
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.puffball.p0: A pale, swollen mushroom of shaded ground. Gathered whole and kept among the witch's stores for workings to come.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.webcap.name: Webcap
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.webcap.p0: An orange-capped mushroom, faintly threaded beneath. Gathered whole and dried for the witch's stores.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.blood_moss.name: Blood Moss
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.blood_moss.p0: A low red moss that creeps over shaded stone and soil. Cut it for the carpet itself — a reagent of Death, it carries the curse of weakness.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.wolfsbane.p0: Wolfsbane is the slowest herb to mature. A classic poison, it lends bite to frailty and bloodwort brews.
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.wormwood.name: Wormwood
hexerei.grimoire.herbs.wormwood.p0: Wormwood grows as a tall stalk, stacking upward. Bitter and potent, it sours brews toward weakness and decay.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.cauldron.name: The Witch's Cauldron
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.cauldron.p0: Fill the cauldron with a water bucket, then light a fire beneath it — flame, lava, magma, or a lit campfire. After it boils, it is ready to brew.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.cauldron.p1: Forged from a ring of iron ingots.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.cauldron.p2: Toss herbs into the boiling water as dropped items; only ingredients that advance a recipe are drawn in. Right-click with a glass bottle to collect the brew, or an empty bucket to rinse a spoiled mix back to water.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.name: Recipes of the Cauldron
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p0: A finished brew matches on the exact set of herbs you add, and draws altar power to complete. These are the recipes the cauldron knows.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p1: Sleeping Draught — Mandrake Root + Belladonna Flower. Costs 50 power, and grants Slowness II and Blindness.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p2: Brew of Frailty — Wolfsbane + Wormwood. Costs 30 power, and grants Weakness II and Mining Fatigue.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p3: Witch's Sight — Icy Needle + Water Artichoke. Costs 40 power, and grants Night Vision and Water Breathing.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p4: Bloodwort Tonic — Mandrake Root + Wolfsbane. Costs 60 power, and grants Strength and Resistance.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p5: Hag's Swiftness — Water Artichoke + Wormwood. Costs 40 power, and grants Speed II and Jump Boost.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p6: Withering Bile — Belladonna Flower + Icy Needle. Costs 30 power, and grants Poison II and Wither.
hexerei.grimoire.brewing.brews.p7: Dreaming Draught — Mandrake Root + Wormwood. This, not the Sleeping Draught, is the key to the dream world: drink it with enough soul-essence and it carries you into a dream. Without essence it only fizzles out.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.circles.name: Laying a Circle
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.circles.p0: A Ritual Circle centre block, ringed by Ritual Glyph chalk marks, performs a rite. A small circle is twelve glyphs in a ring two blocks out, on the centre's level; each glyph needs solid ground beneath it.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.circles.p1: The small circle: twelve glyphs ringing the central sigil.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.circles.p2: Shift+Scroll while holding the chalk to cycle the selected rite; its tooltip shows the rite and the glyph count. Right-click the centre block to draw the whole ring at once.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.circles.p3: The sigil is carved from polished blackstone around a redstone heart.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.circles.p4: To perform: complete the circle, drop the sacrifice item inside, and have a powered altar in range. Right-click the centre — the altar is debited first, then the sacrifice consumed, then the rite runs.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.tempest.name: Rite of the Tempest
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.tempest.p0: Rite of the Tempest — a small circle, one Mandrake Root as the sacrifice, and 100 altar power summon a thunderstorm. The activation scorches the ground and stains the land with taint.
hexerei.grimoire.rituals.bound_beast.p0: Rite of the Bound Beast — a small circle, a sacrifice, and altar power call a wolf familiar to the circle. It is spawned to stay, guarding the spot where it was summoned.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.charms.name: Sealed Amulets
hexerei.grimoire.charms.charms.p0: An amulet is a spirit bound into a charm. A sealing rite (a small circle — see the Rituals chapter) presses a fresh spirit of one domain into the amulet; worn in a pouch, it lends that spirit's nature for as long as its seal holds.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.charms.p1: Forest Amulet — sealed with Celandine as the sacrifice. The wood-warden's endurance: it grants Resistance at all times while worn.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.charms.p2: Death Amulet — sealed with a Crowseye Berry. Its malice turns outward, cursing hostile mobs within five blocks with Weakness.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.charms.p3: Threshold Amulet — sealed with Garlic. The threshold-spirit stirs near death: it grants Strength, but only while you are at three hearts or fewer.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.charms.p4: An amulet is not free, and it is not powered by an altar. Worn, it draws your own soul-debt each second. Debt you do not answer becomes resentment, and resentment grinds the seal — the integrity bar shows how much hold remains. When a seal shatters, the spirit breaks free and disturbs its domain.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.pouch.name: The Charm Pouch
hexerei.grimoire.charms.pouch.p0: The Charm Pouch holds up to three sealed amulets. Right-click to open it and slot your amulets; while the pouch rides anywhere in your inventory, those spirits work passively. The bar on the pouch shows their combined seal integrity.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.pouch.p1: There is no altar recharge here — that was the old way. Each worn amulet spends your soul-debt and grinds its seal a little every second; a shattered amulet is gone for good. Tending a spirit's loyalty (by appeasement — a rite yet to come) slows the grind.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.curses.name: Curses
hexerei.grimoire.charms.curses.p0: A curse weaponizes a spirit against a named victim. First bind a Taglock to your target (right-click them) to capture a thread of their self; then drop the taglock inside a small circle together with the curse's reagent and work the rite. The victim is afflicted — and you bear an echoing cost.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.curses.p1: Curse of Clumsiness — reagent Sandwort (a stone-domain working). Costs 100 altar power.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.curses.p2: Curse of Unluckiness — reagent Glowing Spore (a threshold working). Costs 100 altar power.
hexerei.grimoire.charms.curses.p3: Curse of Weakness — reagent Blood Moss (a death working). Costs 100 altar power.
